fields.description: A host can run more than one bench; this disambiguates which one a row belongs to.
fields.label: Bench Name

fields.description: Genuine append-only history — dashboard charts orphan_worker_count / queue depth over time from it. The "current" state for a host+bench is just its latest row by timestamp (see the (monitored_host, bench_name, timestamp) index) — no separate current-state doctype.
fields.label: Timestamp

fields.description: Count from RQ's Worker.all() against this bench's Redis connection.
fields.label: Registered Workers (Redis)

fields.description: Registered in Redis but no matching live PID. Compared against Host Monitor Settings' orphan worker thresholds.
fields.label: Orphan Worker Count

fields.description: Consecutive polls at/above the critical threshold, no dip — same confirmation-check semantics as _track_severity. Computed at ingest time from the prior row for this (monitored_host, bench_name), since there's no persistent doc to mutate in-memory on an append-only table. The warning threshold drives dashboard color only — there's no separate "Worker Warning" alert type, only this critical-tier streak is tracked/alerted on.
fields.label: Orphan Critical Streak

fields.description: Raw list from the agent payload, kept for diagnostics/drill-down on the host detail view.
fields.label: Live Worker PIDs

fields.description: e.g. {"default": 12, "short": 0, "long": 3}. A queue length climbing across successive rows with orphan/registered counts flat is the "workers stuck, not down" signal.
fields.label: Queue Depths

fields.description: Count of currently-failing jobs for this bench in this push's payload — also drives Frappe Failed Job Log upserts. Compared against Host Monitor Settings' failed job thresholds.
fields.label: Failed Job Count

fields.description: Same critical-tier-only confirmation-check semantics as Orphan Critical Streak.
fields.label: Failed Job Critical Streak
